name: Monotonic Yang Dimension / Monotonic co-VC Dimension (affine)
details: For every finite nonempty binary class, $\mathrm Y^*\ge\mathrm{coVC}^*-1$. This is the max-over-subfamilies lift of the hollow-star bound, with the same additive constant. Since $\mathrm{coVC}^*=\max\{\mathrm S,\mathrm{coVC}\}$, it also gives $\mathrm Y^*\ge\mathrm S-1$. No converse affine bound or endpoint-separation witness is claimed.
proof_source: Proposition \ref{prop:yang-hollow-star} in the LaTeX survey. The proof also identifies subclass hollow stars as filled or hollow stars of the original class.
